title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
About DrFirst

For 25 years, DrFirst has empowered providers and patients to achieve better health through intelligent medication management. We improve healthcare workflows and help patients start and stay on therapy with end-to-end solutions that enhance prescription access, affordability, and adherence. Our solutions help 100 million patients a year and are used by more than 420,000 prescribers, 71,000 pharmacies, 270 EHRs and health information systems, and over 2,000 hospitals in the U.S. This is a great opportunity to be a part of a successful Healthcare IT company experiencing significant growth. Here you'll get to work with some of the smartest and most interesting people around; solving unique and complex challenges in healthcare on a scale matched by a few companies. If you get excited about stretching yourself in new ways, developing yourself to your fullest potential, care about working with smart colleagues; we want to talk to you!
Position Overview
DrFirst is building an agentic ecosystem at scale. In the last 90 days we have shipped production AI systems across HR, Finance, Legal, and Marketing, automating hundreds of hours of manual work monthly and delivering measurable business impact.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You architect and build production AI automation systems from discovery to deployment. You work directly with department leaders to map workflows and ship tools that augment their work.
The split is 80% individual-contributor engineering and 20% servant leadership and mentorship. You build. You own technical architecture decisions. As the team scales from 2 to 5-6 engineers over 18 months, you mentor through code review and pairing. You also teach non-technical department leaders how to use AI tools, translate technical concepts for executives, and run discovery sessions that extract workflows from stakeholders. Building stays your primary focus.
Who Will Love This Job

• You are a senior IC who loves shipping code daily. You have been a Staff or Principal Engineer or led small teams, but you miss hands-on building.

• You can architect multi-agent systems and run discovery sessions with department VPs to map their workflows.

• You can debug OAuth2 flows through enterprise proxies and explain security requirements to non-technical stakeholders.

• You are a servant leader. You remove blockers for others, teach through pairing rather than directives, and make stakeholders successful.

• You organize chaos: 15 stakeholders, 6 systems, 3 sprints in flight. You ask “How can I help?” before “Here is what you should do.”

What you will work on
Build Production AI Automation (80%)
You own the technical implementation of department sprints. Example: an HR sprint delivered resume screening (40-candidate PDF extraction with table-of-contents parsing and fuzzy name matching), OKR coaching (Leapsome API integration with performance rating analytics), performance ratings (calibration detection across 328 employees), and milestone email automation in 4 weeks.

•
Architecture and Implementation: Design and build Python/FastAPI backends connecting to enterprise APIs (HRIS, ERP, CRM, finance systems, project management).

•
Frontend Development: Build Next.js/React frontends with Okta SSO, role-based access control, and audit trails.

•
Multi-Agent Systems: Design agent coordination systems, skill discovery hubs, agent registries, and workflow orchestration.

•
Enterprise Integration: Navigate Zscaler proxies, VPNs, SSL certificates, Kubernetes pod networking, DynamoDB, and AWS Bedrock.

•
Testing and Quality: Write Playwright end-to-end tests before production deploy and maintain a 1000+ test suite with visual regression baselines.

•
Deployment: Ship via GitLab CI/CD to AWS EKS (Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Helm, Secrets Manager) and diagnose pod restarts and liveness probe issues.

•
Async and Performance: Debug event loop blocking, convert synchronous I/O to async, and optimize CPU-bound operations.

You will report to our Head of External Communications and Marketing, and will work closely with our internal communications team, contract communications teams and marketing teams, as well as liaising closely with investor relations, public affairs and external communications agencies.

• Cut the time between a new pattern appearing and a control going live.

• Push prevention upstream with Product and IT: account creation, authentication, device and serial validation, address verification.

• Test identity, device, and voice fraud vendors against our own fraud and clean orders rather than their marketing decks.

title: Firmware Automation Engineer
description:
Imagine a future where everyone has instant, low-cost access to intelligence. We’re building a fully featured European AI cloud - with everything one needs to train, experiment with, and deploy AI models. In addition, our GPUs run on 100% renewable energy.
We’re ambitious, curious, and gutsy doers. We practice a low hierarchy across the company and high morale in our teams. We’ve already achieved a lot, yet we’re only getting started. Now it’s your chance to join the ride. We offer more than just the job - we offer a career-defining opportunity to be part of building something big!
Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished.
About the role
Instead of traditional systems engineering, your focus will be entirely on the silicon and low-level software layers. You will design, build, and maintain the automation frameworks that keep our entire fleet up to date-covering everything from motherboards and Baseboard Management Controllers (BMCs) to high-performance InfiniBand fabrics and GPU clusters. In our "move fast" culture, your job is to build the safety nets (health checks, canary deploys, and automated rollbacks) that allow us to update hardware rapidly without taking down the cloud.
Your Responsibilities

• Fleet-Wide Firmware Orchestration: Design and execute automated, zero-touch firmware update pipelines across our global fleet of servers, switches, and accelerators.

• Heterogeneous Hardware Management: Own the firmware lifecycle for multiple hardware profiles, including Systemboards (BIOS/UEFI), BMCs, InfiniBand HCAs, Network Switches, and high-performance GPUs.

• Redfish & API Automation: Leverage Redfish and IPMI APIs to programmatically discover, configure, inventory, and update bare-metal assets at scale.

• Build Blast-Radius Protections: Architect robust telemetry pipelines to assess hardware health post-flash, and build automated rollback mechanisms to instantly recover from faulty vendor payloads.

• Tooling & Infrastructure as Code: Integrate firmware management pipelines cleanly into our existing configuration management ecosystems (SaltStack/Ansible) and provisioning workflows.

• Vendor & Engineering Liaison: Deep-dive into hardware errata and bug reports, collaborating closely with hardware vendors and internal platform teams to patch critical CVEs and performance regressions.

Your key competencies

• Automation at Scale: Proven experience managing and updating firmware across thousands of nodes simultaneously. You don't do "one-off" flashes; you write code to update clusters.

• Deep Redfish Expertise: Mastery of the DMTF Redfish specification for server management, out-of-band communication, and telemetry collection.

• Hardware Polyglot: Strong understanding of the architectural differences in managing firmware across systemboards, network stacks (InfiniBand/Ethernet), and GPU architectures.

• Failure Domain Expertise: A paranoid mindset regarding hardware health. You know how to verify if a device is truly healthy post-boot and how to safely execute an unattended rollback if it isn't.

• Scripting & Infrastructure Code: Proficiency in Python, Go, or advanced shell scripting alongside configuration management tools (Ansible/Salt) to interact with hardware APIs.

Nice-to-Haves

• Experience working within the OpenBMC ecosystem or building custom BMC firmware images.

• Deep operational familiarity with NVIDIA/Mellanox firmware management tools (mstflint, mlxup).

• Experience managing firmware lifecycles specifically within large-scale AI/ML training clusters or high-performance computing (HPC) environments.

Why Verda

• Cash + equity compensation along with various fringe benefits.

• Profitable operations with rapid, sustained growth.

• 31 nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team.

• An opportunity to make a clear impact and work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem.

Practicalities

• Work mode: Remote (EU)

title: Fincrime Compliance Manager
description:
Read this first

This role is not for most compliance people. It is narrow, exacting and unforgiving of vague work. If the "you will not enjoy this" section describes you, don't apply. We'd rather you didn't.

The job

You find risk, measure it and call it. You do not fix it. Every finding you write answers three things: what is broken, how bad it is, and what evidence proves it. You don't soften the rating and you don't propose the remedy. The business owns the fix. You own the truth about the risk.

What you will do

- Test our BSA/AML, KYC, OFAC and transaction monitoring controls end to end, independently of the teams that run them

- Rate every finding (high / medium / low) with evidence that holds up in front of a regulator

- Pull and analyze data yourself; you don't wait for someone to send you a report

- Challenge thresholds, alert logic and sampling assumptions with numbers, not opinions

- Track open issues until owners close them, and escalate when they don't

- Prepare us for regulator exams and audits, and be the person in the room who already knows the weak spots

What you need (non-negotiable)

- 4+ years in BSA/AML, FinCrime, internal audit or regulatory compliance

- Experience at a top-tier audit/advisory firm, in-house compliance, or both. Both is ideal.

- You have written findings that a regulator, auditor or board actually read

- You can say "this is high risk" to a senior leader and point to the regulation which proves it.

- Deep working knowledge of the BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, OFAC and FinCEN expectations

Nice to have

- Law degree (JD) or bar admission

- Degree in engineering, mathematics, statistics or another STEM field

- SQL: you can query transaction data yourself

- Python or R for analysis, sampling or testing alert logic

- Statistics: sampling design, hypothesis testing, threshold and model validation

CAMS, CRCM, CIA, CISA, CPA or CFE

- Exposure to AI or model risk (SR 11-7, NIST AI RMF)

You will not enjoy this role if

- You prefer building solutions to finding problems

- You need someone else to pull the data for you

- You round risk ratings down to keep people comfortable

- You are uncomfortable being the person no one wants in the meeting

- You uniform to the norm.

We're looking for a practitioner who thinks natively in dimensions, facts, and slowly changing dimensions - someone who knows when to use a full refresh versus an incremental load and how that choice affects idempotency and backfills. Infrastructure tweaks: Writing occasional Terraform for secrets, environment variables, or job sizing when a pipeline needs it.

Pipeline implementation: Building and debugging Python pipelines covering REST/API syncs, large Postgres extracts, Parquet loads, and Snowflake COPY operations.

Airbyte management: Configuring or troubleshooting Airbyte connections wherever managed sync is the right fit.

•
Production monitoring: Watching production runs and investigating failures related to IAM, OOM, Spot instances, or bad watermarks.

title: Senior Agentic Technical Writer
description:
Our Mission

At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.

 

About Us

Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric, with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle, Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what's next.

 

Core Values

• One Team. One Redwood

• Make Your Own Weather

• Obsess over Customer Success

• Work the Problem

• Be Curious

• Own the Outcome

• Respect Each Other

 

Your Impact

Redwood is rebuilding how documentation gets made. Content lives in Git as Markdown, ships through CI/CD, is reviewed by pull request next to product code, and is increasingly drafted by AI agents working from the product requirements, the code, and a structured content model. We are retiring our legacy authoring tool and moving every writer to this way of working.

You will be a senior writer who builds and runs that pipeline. You decide what an agent drafts and what a human must validate, you build the checks that catch failures, and you set the quality bar for AI-generated documentation. You also become a deep subject matter expert on Redwood's products and on the service orchestration and automation platform (SOAP) market they compete in, and you put what you learn back into the content model so every agent and writer inherits it.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You own a program, not a document set: the documentation pipeline and the content for a product area. You choose the approach on new work, guide more junior writers day to day, and have a significant say in documentation decisions for the business area. Not a people manager role.

Build and Run the Agentic Documentation Pipeline

• Design, build, and operate AI-assisted and agentic workflows that draft new content and update existing pages from product requirements, merged code, API specifications, Jira tickets, and release information.

• Define the handoffs: what the agent drafts, what the writer validates, how failures are detected, and how provenance is recorded. Publish the accuracy and review standards the team follows.

• Own the content model and context layer that agents read: structure, terminology, glossary, style rules, reusable components, and product knowledge, so output is consistent and machine-readable for customers, partners, and AI assistants.

• Build automated quality gates in CI: style and terminology linting, link checks, code sample and API reference validation, and an evaluation set that measures draft quality as models and prompts change.

• Detect drift: flag documentation that no longer matches the product after a code or API change.

• Measure the pipeline and report results: cycle time from release to published content, coverage, accuracy defects, reviewer edit effort, and cost per page.

• Keep an honest model of where agents fail on Redwood content, and move the human-AI boundary as models improve.

Docs as Code

• Own the Git workflow, Markdown/MDX authoring, build, and CI/CD publishing for your product area, with pull-request review alongside engineering.

• Lead migration of legacy content into structured, versioned Markdown, including information architecture, redirects, search, and versioning.

• Embed documentation in the delivery lifecycle: docs as a release gate, updates triggered by code and API changes, and documentation work that starts when the product definition is approved, in parallel with engineering rather

title: Account Manager, ACOs & Medicare Supplement (MediGap) Health Plans
description:
About Ceresti Health

Ceresti Health exists because dementia doesn’t just happen to a person - it happens to a family. We’ve built the first national, technology-enabled program that puts family caregivers at the center of dementia care, and we’re one of a small number of organizations selected by CMS to participate in the GUIDE Model. That’s not a credential. It’s a mandate. We’re building the infrastructure to transform how this country cares for people living with dementia - and the Account Manager position for ACOs & Med Supp plans is one of the most important roles in making that real.

Ceresti Health is a tech-enabled dementia care provider pioneering a differentiated model of care to activates family caregivers by giving them the knowledge, skills, and confident to detect an early change in their loved one’s condition. As one of the organizations selected by CMS to participatein the GUIDE Model and almost a decade of experience working in Medicare Advantage populations, we’re at the forefront of transforming dementia care nationwide.

Position Overview

The Account Manager, ACOs & MediGap is a high-ownership, relationship-intensive role at the intersection of performance management, physician awareness and education, carrier relationship development, and organizational change. You will serve as the primary partner for ACOs and Medicare Supplement carriers partnering with Ceresti - helping both ACOs and MediGap carriers strategically leverage the GUIDE Model to impact one of the costliest, most unmanaged cohorts in their populations. The Account Manager is responsible not just for account health, but for building the kind of trust that allows Ceresti to proactively enroll eligible beneficiaries on behalf of partner ACOs and MediGap plans.

This is not a reactive account management role. ACOs are complex organizations with physician stakeholders who are protective of their patient relationships, operational teams managing competing priorities, and leadership who need to see ROI in shared savings and operational relief. MediGapcarriers bring a different but equally complex dynamic - product and actuarial teams evaluating clinical value, compliance teams navigating CMS requirements, and member services teams that need seamless integration with GUIDE Model workflows. Your job is to earn and maintain trust across both channels - and to translate that trust into enrollment performance, program adoption, and measurable outcomes.

You’ll succeed here if you’re energized by complexity, comfortable navigating physician skepticism and carrier procurement cycles, and deeply motivated by what it means to get this right for families living with dementia.

Key Responsibilities

ACO & MediGap Carrier Relationship Management

• Serve as the primary account owner for assigned ACO and MediGap carrier partners from post-implementation through steady state.

• Build strong, trusted relationships with ACO leadership, operations teams, clinical leaders, and care management staff, as well as MediGap carrier product, compliance, and member services teams.

• Understand all components of the GUIDE Model and communicate GUIDE workflows to ACO care teams. For MediGap partners, understand how the GUIDE Model applies within the MediGap context and help carriers operationalize Ceresti's program for their member populations.

• Act as an internal liaison at Ceresti for each partner (ACO or MediGap carrier), ensuring the partner’s needs, constraints, and priorities are clearly understood, communicated, and appropriately addressed.

• Support contract adherence, shared savings alignment (ACOs), GUIDE Model performance targets (MediGap carriers), and ongoing partnership health.

Program Performance & Growth

• Own enrollment performance for assigned ACOs and MediGap carriers, including monitoring physician/care team referral flow (ACOs), member outreach and program utilization (MediGap), outreach effectiveness, and caregiver activation.

• łączenie perspektywy technologicznej i biznesowej.

• osoby z doświadczeniem w koordynowaniu projektów technologicznych oraz współpracy z zespołem,

• osoby ze swobodą w analizie procesów biznesowych i ich optymalizacji,

• znającej narzędzia/obszary takie jak: Power Automate, SQL, PySpark, Power BI (lub podobne),

Poprzez sprawiedliwość chcemy w pełni rozwijać potencjał naszych talentów i zapewnić wszystkim takie same możliwości. Włączenie społeczne jest wymogiem uzupełniającym, aby zapewnić, że każdy czuje się widoczny i słyszany.

title: VP, Sales EMEA
description:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

We are seeking an experienced Vice President, Sales - EMEA to lead StackAdapt's sales organization across the UK, Spain, Germany, France and the UAE. This leader will own the regional sales strategy and lead a geographically dispersed team of sales leaders and Sales Managers, with London as the hub and team members in each of our continental European and Middle Eastern markets.

This role is responsible for driving revenue growth across independent agencies and brands. In the UK, that means owning new and existing brands and independent agencies. In Spain, Germany, France and the UAE, it means building and scaling markets where teams sell across segments, inclusive of holding companies. The ideal candidate brings deep DSP and programmatic advertising experience, strong relationships across the EMEA advertising ecosystem, and a proven track record of leading high-performing sales organizations across multiple markets.

This leader will partner closely with UK Enterprise Sales leadership, Client Services, Agency Development, Marketing, Product, Solutions, Inventory Partnerships, Sales Enablement, Data & Analytics, and Revenue Operations to strengthen StackAdapt's market position and accelerate growth across EMEA.

StackAdapt is a remote-first company; however, our sales teams operate regionally. For this role, we are prioritising candidates located in the UK or EU, ideally in commutable distance to our London hub.

• Own and execute the sales strategy for the UK, Spain, Germany, France and the UAE, with accountability for regional revenue growth, new customer acquisition, and expansion within existing accounts.

• Build leadership depth in each market and set clear expectations, operating rhythms and accountability across time zones and cultures.

• Recruit, coach and develop high-performing sales talent, including the first local leaders in expansion markets, while fostering a connected regional culture.

• Support the team on strategic opportunities, complex negotiations and executive customer relationships.

Customer & Market Leadership

• Build executive-level relationships across independent agencies, holding companies,  and brands in each market.

• Partner with UK Enterprise Sales leadership on multi-market and Holding Company accounts, with a clear operating model to ensure a consistent StackAdapt service motion. Serve as a senior DSP and programmatic leader in strategic pitches, platform evaluations and competitive conversations.

• Represent StackAdapt with senior customers, partners and industry stakeholders across EMEA.

title: DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
was bieten wir?

Bei DACHS IT sollst du nicht einfach nur „eine Stelle“ haben, sondern ein Arbeitsumfeld, das zu deinem Leben, deinen Stärken und deinen Zielen passt. Deshalb bieten wir dir:
Remote-First als gelebtes Modell
Wir arbeiten seit Jahren konsequent remote. Du entscheidest, von wo du am produktivsten bist - Homeoffice, Shared Office oder eine Mischung aus beidem.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Eigenverantwortung
Du kannst dir deine Arbeit im Rahmen der Projekte zeitlich flexibel über die Woche einteilen. Uns sind Verlässlichkeit im Team und transparente Kommunikation wichtiger als Präsenz am Schreibtisch.
Spannende Projekte statt Routine-Tickets
Gemeinsam finden wir Projekte, die zu deinem Profil und deiner Entwicklung passen - z. B. Plattformaufbau, Cloud-Migration, Automatisierung, Operations oder technische Schulungen bei Kund:innen.
Weiterbildung, Zertifizierungen & Wissensaustausch
Regelmäßige Schulungen und Zertifizierungen sind fest eingeplant - mit Kostenübernahme und Freistellung. Dazu kommen interner Wissensaustausch, Sparrings auf Augenhöhe und Raum, dich fachlich wie methodisch weiterzuentwickeln.
Moderne Ausstattung & Arbeitsumgebung
Du erhältst moderne Hardware, die passende Software sowie das benötigte Equipment, damit du effizient und komfortabel arbeiten kannst.
Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen
Neben einem fairen Festgehalt bekommst du eine jährliche Beteiligung am Unternehmensgewinn. Je nach Rolle besteht zudem die Option auf einen Firmenwagen.
Transparente Feedbackkultur & Entwicklung
Wir setzen nicht auf jährliche Pflichttermine, sondern auf regelmäßige, ehrliche Gespräche auf Augenhöhe - du gibst uns Feedback, wir dir. So wissen wir alle, woran wir sind, und können unsere gemeinsamen nächsten Entwicklungsschritte gezielt unterstützen.
Gesundheit, Freizeit & Sicherheit
Du erhältst 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr, die nicht verfallen, sowie zusätzliche Absicherung, zum Beispiel durch eine Gruppen-Unfallversicherung. So bist du nicht nur beruflich, sondern auch privat gut aufgestellt.
Teamkultur & gemeinsame Erlebnisse
Trotz Remote-First ist uns persönlicher Austausch wichtig: Wir treffen uns regelmäßig zu gemeinsamen Aktivitäten - mal locker bei einem Get-together, mal zum gemeinsamen Workshop, mal aktiv bei Ausflügen - und sorgen so für echten Zusammenhalt abseits des Bildschirms.

wen suchen wir?
Wir suchen ein Teammitglied, das unsere Kunden im direkten Kontakt berät, gemeinsam mit ihnen bedarfsorientierte Lösungen entwickelt und sie bei der Umsetzung unterstützt. Du bringst idealerweise Begeisterung, Interesse und erste praktische Erfahrung mit Container- und Cloud-Technologien mit, bist motiviert, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und verfügst über ein empirisch-agiles Mindset sowie ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten. Du arbeitest gern im Team, kannst dich aber auch selbst organisieren, Eigeninitiative zeigen und auf Deutsch wie auf Englisch sicher auf Business Level (C1/C2) kommunizieren. Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt - bei Bedarf auch in Rufbereitschaft oder vor Ort - rundet dein Profil ab.
was machst du bei uns?
Als DevOps Engineer betreust und berätst du unsere Kunden in technischen Fragen rundum die Themen Plattformaufbau, -operations und -integration:

• Du kümmerst dich um den Aufbau und die Konfiguration von Containerplattformen.

• Du verwaltest die Infrastruktur / Cloud / Containerplattform.

• Du automatisierst mittels CI/CD-Pipelines.

• Du übernimmst das Deployment von Anwendungen im Cluster und der Cloud.

• Du bist für Monitoring und Performance Bewertung zuständig.

• Du setzt dich regelmäßig selbstständig und in Schulungen mit den Themen rund um Container- und Cloudtechnologien auseinander und bildest dich weiter.

was bringst du mit?

Technical Skills

Must-have

• Kubernetes

• Linux

• Kenntnisse mindestens eines der folgenden Cloud Stacks

• AWS

• GKE

• MS Azure

• OSP/Openstack

Nice-to-have

• Grundkenntnisse in Terraform

• Grundkenntnisse in Ansible

• Grundkenntnisse der Go L

title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer (Backend Dev - C/DLP/Linux)
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Development Engineering in the Data Protection department. 

In this position, you will serve as a premier technical leader, defining architectural direction, designing high-performance systems-level subsystems, and driving the engineering execution of our next-generation inspection capabilities.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Architect and implement high-performance DLP engines, dictionary compilers, and distributed incident processing pipelines, setting the benchmark for clean, highly optimized systems-level C code running in production proxy runtimes

• Own the technical direction and architectural roadmap for line-rate pattern matching, regular expression evaluators, custom dictionary compilers, exact data match (EDM), and indexed document matching (IDM)

• Help develop next-generation Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions utilizing Machine Learning (ML) models, collaborating with data science teams to successfully deploy and integrate models in high-throughput data paths while balancing inspection capabilities against strict network latency and resource constraints

• Establish and enforce exacting architectural standards for multi-threaded C daemons on FreeBSD/Linux, designing robust shared memory structures, high-performance Inter-Process Communication (IPC), lockless concurrency, and memory-safe subsystems

• Serve as the technical escalation authority for critical production issues-leading hands-on post-mortem core dump analysis, deep system profiling, and leak detection

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You act like an owner with a bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level architectural strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a high-trust collaborator who embraces open feedback, communicates with candor and respect, and champions the collective success of the engineering team.

• You are customer-obsessed, anchoring technical and design decisions in solving real-world challenges for both internal stakeholders and external users.

• You are driven by innovation and intellectual curiosity, continually seeking robust, secure, and scalable approaches to complex systems engineering challenges.

• You lead with integrity and high accountability, building trust through consistent, transparent action and technical stewardship.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• 7+ years of experience with systems software engineering, including a proven track record of a tech lead driving the design and delivery of high-performance backend platforms

• Advanced hands-on proficiency in C programming on Linux or FreeBSD runtime e

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

title: Head of Creative
description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Creative is how millions of people first meet Replit, from a first-time builder to a Fortune 500 buyer. Our product lets anyone turn an idea into working software. The creative challenge is making that feel obvious, exciting and human, whether you’re talking to someone who has never written a line of code or a CIO deciding how their company will build. We believe enterprise marketing doesn’t have to look like enterprise marketing, and we’re looking for the creative leader who believes that too.

As Executive Creative Director, you'll own the creative vision for everything Replit puts into the world: brand campaigns, product launches, the website, social and demand generation. You'll lead our in-house team of designers, and partner closely with product, product marketing, enterprise marketing and the executive team. You'll find the big ideas, sell them to leadership, and get them made at Replit's speed.

This is the right role if you’ve led integrated work that shaped culture and moved the business, both at agencies and inside tech companies, and across consumer and B2B brands. You can write and art direct well enough to tell a good idea from a great one, and you’d rather build an in-house creative engine than manage a roster of agencies.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Set the creative vision: Define how Replit looks, sounds and feels across every touchpoint, from major brand moments to product launches to everyday social

- Lead big ideas end to end: Take integrated campaigns from brief to concept to production across film, OOH, social, web, events and paid, all organized around a single idea

- Raise the craft bar: Push for higher production value, especially in video and motion, and know when to push for perfect and when to ship

- Build and lead the team: Manage and develop designers, art directors and copywriters, grow senior talent into leaders, and hire where the team has gaps

- Run the creative engine: Own intake, briefing and creative review so work comes in early with a clear strategy and goes out on-brand; decide what stays in-house, what goes to freelancers, and when an agency or production partner is worth it

- Make AI part of the craft: Build AI creative tools into how the team concepts, produces and iterates, with a clear point of view on where human taste matters most

- Champion the work: Present and defend creative to executives and cross-functional partners with clear strategic rationale and conviction

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- 12+ years of creative leadership at a top agency and/or an in-house consumer tech brand, with a portfolio of culturally relevant work that drove business results

- Conceptual and craft range across verbal and visual: campaign ideas, brand platforms, verbal identity and art direction

- Proven experience at both B2C and B2B brands and businesses, leading integrated campaigns across film, social, OOH, digital and experiential

- Strong video and motion instincts, including directing higher-production shoots with production partners

- Track record of building or scaling an in-house creative team, and recruiting, developing and retaining top talent

- Experience making complex or technical products simple, emotional and accessible

- Executive presence: you can sell a bold idea to a CEO and explain why it matters to the business

- Comfort in a fast, lean, ambiguous environment where you set the strategy and stay hands-on in the work

- Based in or able to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area

BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience at an AI, developer-tool or product-led growth company

- Hands-on use of generative AI creative tools, with evidence of building them into team workflows

- Work recognized at Cannes, D&AD or One

title: Account Executive, Multi-location

Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About The Role

About Patronus AI

Patronus AI is a frontier lab developing simulation research and infrastructure to accelerate progress toward human-aligned AGI. We are on a mission to simulate all of the world’s intelligence.

We are the team behind some of the earliest and most influential research in AI evaluation likeFinanceBench, Lynx,SimpleSafetyTests,CopyrightCatcher,Humanity’s Last Exam, and more. We are formerly AI researchers and engineers from companies like Meta AI, Amazon AGI, and Google. Our customers include foundation model labs and Fortune 500 enterprises like Adobe. We are backed by top-tier investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Notable Capital, Stanford University, Noam Brown, Gokul Rajaram, and more.

At a glance

•
Engagement: Independent contractor, remote, on your own schedule

•
Pay: $150 per hour

•
Commitment: 10 to 30 hours per week

•
Start: Rolling

•
Location: Remote

The role
You'll help us create RL tasks related to embedded hardware that test and train AI models

• Design realistic tasks that take an experienced engineer about a working day

• Build the sandboxed setup each task needs (Verilog or VHDL, FPGA toolchains, simulators and test benches, hardware drivers, sensor and bus interfaces), your own solution and checks a tester could verify without opinion

• Review tasks other experts build

Who we're looking for

• 3+ years building and validating embedded hardware yourself (board design, FPGA or HDL, bring-up and test), managerial experience is a bonus

• Still in the role, or left recently

•
Required: Previous AI data labeling, data annotation, or RL task creation experience

Our standards

• Nothing copied from published sources, and no code, configs or data from a current or former employer or client. Every system and scenario is fictional.

• AI tools are allowed as an aid but you are ultimately responsible and evaluated for your own work.

How hiring works

• Short AI interview and resume review

• One paid trial task, scored against a fixed quality checklist

• Onboarding and your first project
